fields.title: Choose What to Optimize
fields.inputs/0/label: Speed up serialization by half, 1 week
fields.promptBlocks/0/text: Screen 2.4 s. Components: images 780 ms (33%), database queries 620 ms (26%), network 480 ms (20%), serialization 210 ms (9%), rendering 190 ms (8%), other 120 ms.
fields.promptBlocks/1/text: The team proposes three tasks: speed up serialization by half (1 week), prepared image sizes (4 days), batch database queries (2 weeks). What do you take?
fields.referenceReasoningBlocks/0/text: serialization — maximum 4.5% gain, reject. Images — up to 33%, four days, take first. Queries — up to 26%, two weeks, take second. Order by return per day of work: images yield ~8% per day, queries ~2.6%, serialization ~0.9%. Technique: estimate the maximum gain before discussing timelines.
